events.title: Law enforcement misuses less-lethal weapons against ICE detention facility protesters
events.summary: A report released this week identified 412 instances in which law enforcement officers have misused "less-lethal weapons," such as tear gas and rubber bullets, against protesters at Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention facilities. The report, covering the period from June 2025 to May 2026, also found 203 instances of injuries resulting from this misuse. The widespread pattern of weapon misuse against protesters raises serious concerns about excessive force and violation of constitutional rights.
events.why_relevant: Systematic misuse of force against protesters at federal detention facilities violates constitutional protections for assembly and petition, and demonstrates inadequate oversight of law enforcement conduct.
